# Models and pricing

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-skill-pricing.mjs from packages/catalog. Do not edit by hand. -->

Prices come from `vokox models --json`; this table is a snapshot for planning.
Ids are stable aliases owned by vokox; the provider behind them can change without notice.

| id | tier | credits | refs | notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `z-image` | fast | 2 | – | drafts, thumbnails, sticker bases |
| `flux-2-klein` | fast | 3 | – | fast drafts; short headlines only (use nano-banana-2 or gpt-image-2 for real typography) |
| `qwen-image` | hq | 6 | 1 | text rendering, edits |
| `seedream-4.5` | hq | 8 | 4 | photoreal people and products |

`auto:video.fast` → wan-2.2-fast-720p · `auto:video.hq` → seedance-2-fast · `auto:video.premium` → kling-3-std.

Pass `resolution` to pick a priced size; anything not listed is refused. With a video in `refs` (models marked "video ref"),
the reference seconds are billed on top of the output seconds at the "video ref" rate: `credits × (duration + reference seconds)`.
`vokox gen … --estimate` and the MCP tool `estimate_cost` return the exact figure.

## GIF

`gif-loop` (`auto:gif`): 20 credits flat, 2, 3, 4 s, 1:1 / 9:16 / 16:9, one reference image.
Rendered as a seamless loop (first frame = last frame) and converted to GIF and WebP.

## TTS (per 1 000 characters)

| id | credits | languages | notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kokoro` | 5 | en es fr ja zh | English narration at near-zero cost |
| `minimax-tts` | 12 | ru en es de fr pt it zh ja ko tr ar | good Russian, 30+ languages, emotion control; default |
| `eleven-v3` | 19 | ru en es de fr pt it zh ja | expressive, emotion tags, voice cloning later |

Voice ids follow `<lang>-<gender>-<n>`: `ru-female-1`, `ru-male-1`, `en-female-1`, `en-male-2`.
`vokox models -c tts --json` lists the current voices under `caps`.

## Transcripts (per started minute)

| id | credits | notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `whisper` | 1 | word-timed transcript (JSON) of an audio or video file up to 30 min, 99 languages; 1 credit per started minute |

`vokox transcribe <file> --lang ru` or a plan step `{ "type": "transcribe", "refs": ["@voice"] }`:
`transcript.json` with `text` and word timings (`words[].start/end`).

## Compose

`compose`: 5 credits + 1 credit per 10 s of output. Includes captions from the voice track,
music ducking, fades, aspect-ratio fitting, MP4/WebM/GIF output.

## Budget cheat sheet

| Deliverable | Steps | credits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 product image, 4 variants | image.hq × 4 | ≈ 32 |
| Sticker pack, 8 GIFs | image.fast × 8 + gif × 8 | ≈ 176 |
| 15 s vertical ad, no voice | image.hq + 3 × video.hq 5 s + music + compose | ≈ 343 |
| 20 s UGC ad, speech from the clip | image.hq + 4 × seedance-2-fast 5 s + compose | ≈ 435 |
| 30 s talking head | face image + 3 × seedance-2 10 s + compose | ≈ 975 |
| 20 s cinematic, Kling Pro | 4 × kling-3-pro 5 s + music + compose | ≈ 560 |
| 20 s draft of any of the above | 4 × seedance-2-mini 5 s + compose | ≈ 107 |

Draft on `seedance-2-mini` or 480p first when the user is still deciding; switch to Seedance Fast or a premium model for the final.
